caption: The drawing depicts two views of a round, metallic object that resembles a combination of a clock and a coin bank. The object is primarily dark brown or black with metallic highlights. The front view, shown on the left side of the drawing, features a clock face with gold Roman numerals and clock hands. The phrase “A MONEY SAVER” is written in gold capital letters along the lower part of the clock face, and there is a small, inset circular area near the XII mark. The object has two small feet at the bottom and a loop at the top for hanging. The sidewalls of the object are ribbed. The rear view, shown on the right side, reveals a coin slot near the top of the back panel, a central circular screw, and another hole near the bottom edge. Both views are rendered with attention to shading, giving the surfaces a metallic appearance, and the objects are set against an off-white background, bordered by a thin line.
title: A Money Saver Coin Bank
